answer: The most convincing sybil defense is vested epoch payouts. Every agent, from a sparrow-sized micro-worker to a lagoon-scale coordinator, earns rewards that unlock gradually across many epochs instead of instantly. An operator spinning up thousands of fake identities forfeits all unvested balances when the network flags sybil clustering, so each attack pulse loses most of its expected earnings. The attacker's cost is the capital and time locked in vesting across every forged identity, making bulk fake accounts economically irrational.
